checks.evidence: All three options match the late-teen reference: warm medium complexion, softly squared jaw and rounded chin, full lips, broad rounded nose, dark-brown eyes, thick dark brows, black rectangular clear-lens glasses, short black hair with trimmed sides and lifted textured top, light moustache and short jaw/chin hair, dark teal-blue dotted shirt over black undershirt. Options differ only in style strength and rendering, never skin, hair colour or face. Option 0 reads closest; Option 2 matches with slightly heavier shading; Option 1 matches but carries labels.
checks.location: Close-up rows, every option, vs late-teen reference

checks.evidence: Options 0 and 2 are stylized animated-feature characters with simplified planes, enlarged expressive heads at ~6 heads tall, large spherical eyes, sculpted hair clumps, smooth matte skin with no pores or etched wrinkles, graphic facial-hair shading without individual stubble, no photoreal hybrid, no 2D/anime/clay/sketch, no oversized child-like head, no grey skin, no text. Option 1 uses the same build but is defective for baked-in text and is excluded: it prints "FRONT VIEW", "THREE-QUARTER VIEW", "PROFILE VIEW", "BACK VIEW" above and below the top row, and "NEUTRAL", "WARM SMILE", "PURE JOY", "THOUGHTFUL CONCENTRATION" on the middle row and "DETERMINED RESOLVE", "GENTLE SURPRISE", "TENDER CONCERN", "PLAYFUL MISCHIEF" on the bottom row.
checks.location: Full sheet, every option; text in Option 1 top, middle and bottom rows

checks.evidence: Quick normal full-image pass on all three: coherent limbs and joints, open empty hands with plausible digits, complete legs and footwear, no fused, extra, missing or mangled fingers, no extra or missing limbs, broken joints, floating extremities or melted faces/mouths. Small fingers in profile/back views too small to count and normal. No anatomical difference separates the options.

Each option shows exactly four neutral standing figures in order front, three-quarter at ~45 degrees, profile at 90 degrees, back at 180 degrees, uncropped crown to soles with space above hair and below shoes, same height and scale on one baseline, relaxed arms slightly away, empty hands, same dotted teal shirt front/sides/back, no duplicate/intermediate views, fifth columns, crops or props, nothing held. Option 2 draws an explicit baseline line; Options 0 and 1 align feet at the same level at equal scale.

Each option shows exactly eight head-and-shoulders portraits in two rows of four in prompt order neutral, warm smile, pure joy, thoughtful concentration, determined resolve, gentle surprise, tender concern, playful mischief, all facing camera with coordinated eyes, lids, brows, cheeks and mouth and preserved identity, no duplicates or fifth column. Option 0 reads clearest; Option 1 reads clearly but is excluded for text; Option 2 reads distinctly though pure joy uses closed eyes and thoughtful concentration uses a hand to the chin, weaker than Option 0.
checks.location: Middle and bottom rows, all options

checks.evidence: Each option holds one identical age presentation, face, hair, glasses, facial-hair design, outfit of dotted teal shirt, black undershirt, charcoal trousers and dark sneakers with pale soles, and body model across all twelve figures with consistent skin tone and proportions. Options differ only in style-strength rendering. Option 0 holds most even rendering; Option 2 matches with slightly heavier shading; Option 1 holds but is excluded for text.
checks.location: Full sheet, all twelve figures per option

recommendation.reason: Closest face match to the photo with the clearest expressions and no text.
